notes: What's new: this build speaks the current version of Meta's glasses toolkit (DAT 1.1.0), matching the software on glasses today — on the older toolkit the glasses camera could refuse to start streaming. And when the camera doesn't start, the app now says what actually happened — timed out, stopped, or closed — with the glasses' own error wording when they give one. Everything else is the 0.3.0 you know: the full video player, the truth-telling record screen, voice commands, one sign-up library, and in-app updates.
